title: XAI-2026 pre-registration — SecEdge-3.8B explanation and uncertainty
status_at_registration: Phase 0 gates passed; no test-draw record generated or scored yet.

frozen_inputs.llama_cpp_build: b10155 (1cbfd1988), CUDA, greedy, grammar secedge_decision.gbnf / secedge.gbnf

draws.val_cal: validation split, stratified by Attack_type, <=250 per class, pandas sample random_state=2026 — fitting only

calibrators: stack(logistic on logit v, log pmax, margin, entropy, logit gate pmax, logit gate p(label), agreement)
analysis.primary_selection: primary calibrator = lowest 5-fold-CV ECE on val; primary ranking signal = highest 5-fold-CV AUROC on val; test never used for selection
analysis.uncertainty: flow-level percentile bootstrap (2,000 for per-method CIs; 10,000 for paired primary-vs-verbal deltas)
analysis.conformal: split conformal on temperature-scaled intrinsic distribution; LAC primary, APS secondary; Mondrian (class-conditional) primary, marginal secondary; alpha in {0.10,0.05,0.01}; calibration = val_cal only
analysis.ambiguous_flow: test flow whose rendered flow block occurs in the TRAIN split with >=2 distinct labels (vectorised renderer validated against build_flow_block)
analysis.deferral: threshold fixed on val to catch 40.6% of val errors; report correct-deferred per error caught on test; baseline = verbal confidence with the deployed 0.50 floor

targets.A-T1: primary calibrator test ECE <= 0.03 and 95% CI upper <= 0.04
targets.A-T2: primary ranking test AUROC(correct vs incorrect) >= 0.90
targets.A-T4: Mondrian LAC alpha=0.05 on test: every class coverage >= 0.95 - tolerance; mean set size <= 1.30; singleton rate >= 0.85
targets.A-T5: multi-label-set rate on ambiguous test flows >= 3x the rate on unambiguous flows
targets.A-T6: <= 2 correct deferrals per error caught at the val-fixed 40.6% catch threshold (primary ranking signal)
targets.B-T1: descriptive: hallucinated-value and unobservable-claim rates of full-schema rationales (test_sub1500), with Wilson 95% CIs
targets.B-T3: evidence-bound explanation comprehensiveness@3 >= 1.5x template-cited-field comprehensiveness@3, with 0 hallucinated values and 0 unobservable claims
targets.B-T4: SLM-counterfactual vs gate-TreeSHAP top-3 overlap >= 0.6 => SHAP certified as on-device attribution proxy (< 5 ms)
targets.C-T1: direction (paired): Q4_K_M has larger mean conformal set size and higher unobservable-claim rate than Q8_0
targets.D-T1: GPU vs Pi 5: label agreement >= 99% and mean |delta pmax| <= 0.02 on 150 flows
targets.D-T2: trie scoring adds <= 10% to on-device decision latency

reporting_rule: every target is reported PASS or FAIL as measured; no target, threshold or analysis choice is changed after registration; deviations are listed explicitly.
